question: Motion to Invoke Cloture: Motion to Proceed to S. 4784
result: Cloture on the Motion to Proceed Rejected (50-46, 3/5 majority required)
bill_title: National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027
plain_language: This vote would end debate on whether to take up S. 4784 (National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027), which sets forth policies and authorities for FY2027 for Department of Defense programs, activities, and military construction as well as the national security programs of the Department of Energy. Cloture needs 60 votes (three-fifths of the Senate). A Yea moves the Senate toward taking up the bill; a Nay keeps debate open.

question: Motion to Proceed to the House Message to Accompany S. 1318
bill_title: Fallen Servicemembers Religious Heritage Restoration Act
plain_language: This vote is on whether the Senate takes up S. 1318, which carries the Foreign Intelligence Accountability Act and the Anti-CBDC Surveillance State Act as passed by the House; it reauthorizes Title VII of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act until April 30, 2029, with added protections related to Section 702, and bars Federal Reserve banks from issuing a central bank digital currency or offering accounts directly to individuals. A Yea begins consideration; a Nay blocks it for now.

question: Motion to proceed to S.J. Res. 103
bill_title: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Department of Veterans Affairs relating to "Reproductive Health Services".
plain_language: This vote is on whether the Senate takes up S.J.Res. 103, whose official title is “A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Department of Veterans Affairs relating to "Reproductive Health Services"”. A Yea begins consideration; a Nay blocks it for now.
